Px to Rem Converter

Convert px to rem and rem to px instantly with a configurable root font size — plus a quick reference table of common values.

–
Result
pxrem

📖 How to use

  1. Set your root font size (default 16px).
  2. Type a px value to get rem, or a rem value to get px.
  3. Use the table for common conversions at a glance.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I convert px to rem?

Divide the px value by the root font size (default 16px): 24px ÷ 16 = 1.5rem.

What if my root font size is not 16px?

Type it in the root font-size field — the conversion and table update live.

What is the difference between rem and em?

rem is relative to the root (<html>) font size; em is relative to the parent element's font size.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
